LESSON: A random, field-independent third-derivation audit (this review's 60-pair legal_description check) can simultaneously CONFIRM a mechanism's soundness on the axis it was designed to guard against AND miss a real defect on a different axis (the shared-situs-on-the-R-side direction) that nobody's uniqueness check was ever written to catch -- confirming a control works as designed is not the same as confirming it has no other exposure; both need separate, deliberately different falsifiers.

gh search code across an entire GitHub org is a fast, cheap, high-confidence way to answer 'does anything consume this table' when a full multi-repo clone-and-grep would be prohibitively expensive -- worth reaching for earlier in any future review of a store's downstream reach.
